children: Brazilian Finance Minister Dario Durigan said at a news conference in Sao Paulo on Friday that Brazil will not refund licensing fees to betting companies. According to Sina Finance, the government has assessed the impact of the gambling ban on various industries.

The government will also hold talks with football clubs and the football association about their debt issues. Planning Minister Bruno Moretti said the "Brazil Debt Relief Plan 3.0" will buy and restructure household debt from financial institutions, and that the plan will affect the core fiscal budget. The government will reallocate spending and include the debt purchases in budget arrangements.

title: Brazil Will Not Refund Licensing Fees to Betting Companies
